page.notes: Hebrew, Syriac and Chaldee words are printed in Hebrew/Syriac letters and are not reproduced here in full; only the Latin text and references were transcribed exactly. Vowel-pointed Hebrew forms could not be read letter by letter and are shown as placeholders in the text.
